What_it_contains: Scrap arrivals/logistics from an electric steel plant. Fields include load ID, transport, dates, supplier code, scrap-type code, weight [kg], soil/water/other contaminants [kg].

Limitations: Does not contain chemical composition, recovery yield or economic outcome. ScrapType codes are identifiers; do not invent their meanings.

Real_or_synthetic_status: Real experimental measurements from selected samples.
Limitations: Not representative of all factories or all waste streams. Preserve sample IDs, units and qualifiers.
